trios.title: Die unzuständige Zelle
trios.source: Original escape-gang archetypes; broad striped-prisoner cartoon memory, no existing character copies.
trios.anchor: tiny black/ivory STRIPED cloth collars and little soft striped caps, ONE dull-red square patch each, exposed dark goo bodies

actors.name: Herr Fluchtweg
actors.design: TALL skinny hooked upright ink bean, one long sagging crown lobe, one enormous lower ivory tooth. Unequal wide WHITE/red/black eyes DOWN, worried crooked CLOSED lower lip. Hugs ONE rolled blank cream escape sketch with ONE short fat red carpenter pencil tucked in fold.
actors.personality: He has identified an exit for every eventuality except the present one.

actors.name: Frau Löffelrecht
actors.design: SHORT very WIDE blunt-lobed ink splat, TWO low crown nubs, subtle lashes, THREE widely spaced upper teeth. One eye squints shut with effort, other forward, side-clenched tooth grimace. Grips ONE absurdly broad bent steel SOUP SPOON against own belly like her entire practical education.
actors.personality: She regards the wall as an unresolved question of cutlery.

actors.name: Herr Bewährungsangst
actors.design: ROUND upright dumpling ink blob, crown forms THREE tiny offset drops, TWO big lower teeth, heavy trembling lip. White/red/black eyes stare SIDEWAYS, pinched worried half-open underbite. Both goo hands protect ONE tiny patched brown drawstring BUNDLE with a little blank ivory tag, no loot spilling.
actors.personality: He packed for freedom and is concerned about the return policy.

trios.title: Der ordentliche Einbruch
trios.anchor: little BURGUNDY knit caps with a TEAL stitched patch and short cream neckerchiefs, no suits covering bodies

actors.name: Herr Schließzustand
actors.design: MEDIUM narrow upright pear ink blob, stiff sideways crown curl, thick upper lip and ONE crooked upper tooth. Half-lidded judgmental side-eye, CLOSED pursed lip. Holds ONE enormous old brass KEY and ONE short fat blunt lock pick together low at belly, simple readable tools.
actors.personality: He objects to locks mainly on procedural grounds.

actors.name: Frau Fernverdacht
actors.design: TALL leaning inverted-drop ink splat, TWO antenna-like rounded crown lobes, subtle lashes, asymmetrical upper fangs. One eye CLOSED and one WHITE/red/black very wide looking outward, crooked small tense mouth. Hugs ONE stubby thick battered BRASS SPYGLASS at her own belly, not looking through it or pointing at another actor.
actors.personality: She has seen trouble coming and would like it to make an appointment.

actors.name: Herr Leerlauf
actors.design: WIDE low upright bean splat with a huge coiled crown loop, ONE square lower tooth, sleepy drooping lids. Exhausted unimpressed WHITE/red/black gaze and enormous CLOSED pout. Holds ONE small three-spoke BLACK rubber steering wheel with iron hub, loose in both goo hands, no car.
actors.personality: He is ready to leave as soon as everyone stops making this urgent.

args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB cartoon claymation ink blob STORY TRIOS. ONE landscape1536x1024 TRUE TRANSPARENT PNG, EXACTLY THREE columns TWO rows=SIX DIFFERENT standalone CHARACTERS. Top row THREE different individuals in ONE trio; bottom row THREE DIFFERENT individuals in a SECOND trio. THIS IS NOT A TIER/CAREER/EMOTION progression. Never repeat one identity across row. Three means a crowd: each row belongs together by restrained costume/material motif and complementary personality, but each actor must function independently outside group. No handoffs, pointing at neighbour, overlaps or shared objects.
Reference image1 ORIGINAL freche-family for whole dark INK morphology/material; image2 ORIGINAL props reference for modeling craft only. STYLE REFERENCES, NOT edit targets or character templates. No likenesses of actors/musicians, no film still reconstruction, all are ORIGINAL grotesque ink blobs.
FAMILY INVARIANTS: complete UPRIGHT FOOTLESS charcoal/deep-violet rounded ink SPLATS with thick soft asymmetrical goo lobes, subtle violet sheen, tactile modeled plasticine/fingerprints, sculpted lids/lips and uneven ivory teeth. Hands are goo continuous with body. No humanoid torso/legs/feet/busts, no whole coats/robes hiding goo. Dark ink face/body dominant, accessories small and readable. Every OPEN eye has WHITE/ivory sclera surrounding separate RED iris and BLACK pupil. Planned cyclops has same colour rule. No all-red/glowing eyeballs. Offbeat absurd/surreal satirical peak acting, not generic cute Pixar babies, no repeated V-brow tooth grin. Differentiate body contour, eye/lid shapes, mouth, posture and temperament BEFORE props. Some mouths closed, some open, unequal gazes; NO protruding tongue in ANY cell.
LAYOUT: equal512x512 cells, each ENTIRE actor and all own droplets/props inside MAX384x384 box with64px transparent margins ALL sides. Centres(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256),(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Never cross x512,x1024,y512. Similar overall body size, no giant boss. Few bold simple functional handmade props, rich softly rounded wood/metal/cloth, not machinery clutter. Entire figure isolated, no floor/cast shadows/scenelet/scenery/extra heads.

trios.title: Drei gegen die Stille
trios.source: Original jazz trio; no named musicians or likeness references.
trios.anchor: tiny midnight-blue collars, little COPPER oval pins and one restrained CORAL cloth accent each

actors.name: Frau Atemvorbehalt
actors.design: TALL curving upright ink pear, high flowing crown quiff, long lids/lashes, TWO offset ivory upper teeth. One eye blissfully shut and one sideways, strong curved closed lip. Holds ONE short beautifully rounded BRASS SAXOPHONE with thick curved bell and THREE large keys at own belly, mouthpiece clear of face.
actors.personality: She considers silence a promising place to begin a disagreement.

actors.name: Herr Grundton
actors.design: VERY WIDE low heavy upright ink splat, three blunt crown lobes, single big lower tusk. Low patient half-lids, CLOSED solemn downturned lip. Hugs ONE compact fat WOODEN DOUBLE BASS with short neck and THREE thick strings, entire instrument at belly with NO endpin/floor, goo face/body dominant.
actors.personality: He keeps the group together by refusing to hurry.

actors.name: Herr Nebenbeat
actors.design: SMALL narrow tilted upright goo bean, one springy crown hook, FOUR tiny irregular upper teeth. Both WHITE/red/black eyes wide and asymmetric, delighted sideways clenched-tooth grin. ONE small copper-rimmed SNARE DRUM strapped LOW to own belly, ONE short fat wooden stick in each goo hand, no kit/stool.
actors.personality: He heard the pause and has taken responsibility for correcting it.

trios.title: Die angekündigte Ruhestörung
trios.source: Original garage-punk trio; no celebrity likenesses.
trios.anchor: small worn plum collars with a MUSTARD stitch and tiny dull-copper hardware, no leather human torsos

actors.name: Frau Lautantrag
actors.design: BROAD upright triangular ink splat, THREE thick crown waves like soft goo mohawk, lashes, TWO big uneven lower teeth. Defiant furious OPEN underbite SHOUT, one eye squeezed, no tongue. Holds ONE fat old black MICROPHONE with copper stem at belly, no stand or cable.
actors.personality: She has submitted the complaint at its intended volume.

actors.name: Herr Akkordresten
actors.design: TALL thin stooping-but-UPRIGHT bean, long drooping crown lobe, ONE off-centre upper ivory fang. Suspicious concentrated crosswise gaze, CLOSED lip biting tooth. Hugs ONE short rounded battered mustard ELECTRIC GUITAR with plum pickguard and THREE fat strings, no amp/cables.
actors.personality: He knows one chord thoroughly enough to distrust the others.

actors.name: Herr Eimermaß
actors.design: VERY ROUND low upright ink dumpling, TWO tiny side crown nubs, large soft lower lip and THREE sparse upper teeth. Enormous delighted open tooth LAUGH, one eye shut, NO tongue. Holds ONE dented upside-down steel BUCKET as a small belly drum, ONE short fat wooden kitchen spoon for striking, no floor.
actors.personality: He brought the instrument that was available and now considers it essential.

trios.title: Der gemeinsame freie Tag
trios.source: Original adult family: matriarch, adult son, grandfather.
trios.anchor: little burgundy cloth collars with ONE small IVORY oval button and modest worn cream household props

actors.name: Tante Letztentscheid
actors.design: WIDE upright heavy bell ink blob with TWO rolled crown curls tied in tiny ivory kerchief, lashes, ONE huge upper tooth. Terrifyingly cordial CLOSED crooked smile, high rounded brows and one half-lid. Holds ONE squat old cream PORCELAIN TEAPOT with thick copper lid, no cup/pouring.
actors.personality: She has invited everyone to enjoy the day according to her arrangement.

actors.name: Herr Familiensonntag
actors.design: TALL very narrow drooping ink pear, one long sagging crown hook, TWO small offset lower teeth. Unequal white/red/black eyes look UP, tired worried sagging underbite. Hugs ONE small cream PLATE holding ONE lonely crumbled toast corner, all attached to own hands.
actors.personality: He was told there would be no obligations today.

actors.name: Opa Zeitreserve
actors.design: COMPACT almost-square ROUND-lobed upright ink splat with three low crown nubs, heavy wrinkled lids, single ivory lower tusk. Offended teeth-clenched sideways stare. Both goo hands hold ONE enormous old copper ALARM CLOCK with fat bells and BLANK face with TWO physical hands only, no digits.
actors.personality: He arrived early to establish that everyone else was late.

trios.title: Die letzte trockene Stelle
trios.anchor: tiny faded TEAL work caps with little COPPER circles, short ochre work collars; dark ink bodies exposed

actors.name: Frau Hauptabsperrung
actors.design: TALL broad upright rounded trapezoid ink blob, TWO strong sideways crown curls, lashes, THREE uneven upper teeth. One brow high and other eye narrowed, CLOSED compressed severe lower lip. Holds ONE thick old red PIPE WRENCH, short and beautifully rounded, no pipe maze.
actors.personality: She can stop the leak as soon as everyone stops explaining it.

actors.name: Herr Dichtungslehre
actors.design: SMALL lanky tilted ink bean, one springy crown nub, ONE enormous square lower tooth. Huge wide asymmetric eyes DOWN, crooked nervous lip. Carefully holds ONE massive black RUBBER WASHER with clear round hole as though it were the missing answer, no extra tools.
actors.personality: He has found the spare part and is waiting to discover what it replaces.

actors.name: Herr Abnahmetermin
actors.design: VERY WIDE low upright ink splat, three thick blunt crown lobes, two tiny upper fangs, thick heavy lower lip. Disapproving nearly closed WHITE/red/black eyes, CLOSED lip folded into a long pout. Hugs ONE short silver PIPE ELBOW fitted with ONE chunky brass pressure gauge, blank face/two thick hands only; compact self-contained prop.
actors.personality: He has detected a discrepancy between the water and the paperwork.

trios.title: Macbeth · Krone, Fleck, Vorhersage
trios.source: Shakespeare Macbeth, loose KFB archetypal interpretation; no actor likeness.
trios.anchor: tiny faded TERRACOTTA cloth accents and worn copper trim linking three different tragic archetypes

actors.name: König Vielleichtmorgen
actors.design: WIDE upright chunky ink splat, one split crown curl, TWO uneven lower tusks. Panicked side-looking WHITE/red/black eyes and crooked clenched teeth. Tiny battered copper CROWN tilted too far, short terracotta plaid collar. Holds ONE short thick dull ceremonial DAGGER low at own belly, no blood/action/victim.
actors.personality: He has acquired the crown and misplaced the future.

actors.name: Lady Fleckenfreiheit
actors.role: Lady Macbeth archetype: relentless guilt manager
actors.design: TALL narrow upright ink pear, TWO smooth rolled crown lobes, heavy lashes, ONE sharp upper ivory tooth. Fixed cold wide gaze DOWN, CLOSED taut crooked lip. Tiny terracotta velvet-like collar with copper clasp, one little ivory hairpin. Both hands squeeze ONE large worn IVORY SOAP BAR over ONE tiny cream wash bowl held against own belly, no water scene.
actors.personality: She has removed every visible objection except the one she can remember.

actors.name: Frau Vorhersagbar
actors.design: SHORT ROUND upright ink dumpling, crown nubs under SMALL crooked dark-plum witch cap with terracotta patch, lashes, THREE sparse upper teeth. One WHITE/red/black eye wide and one squint shut, mischievous asymmetrical OPEN laugh with NO tongue. Hugs ONE small round black clay CAULDRON with fat copper rim and ONE very short wooden spoon, no smoke/spell FX.
actors.personality: Her prediction is entirely accurate within a suitably flexible interpretation.

trios.title: Hamlet · Frage, Zeuge, Altlast
trios.source: Shakespeare Hamlet, loose KFB archetypal interpretation; no actor likeness.
trios.anchor: small midnight-blue collars, worn IVORY and dull brass props, different faces/body contours

actors.name: Prinz Aufschub
actors.role: Hamlet archetype: prince of deferred decisions
actors.design: TALL bent upright ink bean, ONE long drooping crown lobe, one big upper tooth and tiny lower fang. Unequal wide WHITE/red/black eyes looking DOWN, heavy uncertain CLOSED pout. Tiny dark cap with short ivory feather and small blue princely collar. Holds ONE simple rounded little IVORY THEATRICAL SKULL at belly, no bones/gore elsewhere.
actors.personality: He has narrowed the decision down to the question.

actors.name: Herr Nachtrag
actors.design: WIDE low upright ink splat with three blunt crown nubs, tiny navy soft cap, TWO offset upper teeth. Weary knowing half-lidded side gaze and CLOSED little crooked lip. Holds ONE small plain leather NOTEBOOK and ONE fat ivory quill, no writing/text.
actors.personality: He was asked to remember the facts and has remained inconveniently available.

actors.name: Vater Unabgeschlossen
actors.design: MEDIUM upright round-bottom ink bell, TWO backward crown curls, huge lower lip and ONE tiny upper fang. Stern affronted one-brow glare, CLOSED downturned lip. Small battered GREY knight brow helmet with broken brass crest and very short navy collar; one goo hand holds ONE fat old brass KEY, no transparency/ghost FX, no full armour.
actors.personality: He has returned because the matter was not left in the approved state.
